title: openwiz.fleet.v1
description: The JSON printed by openwiz fleets --json and openwiz fleet <spec> --json (OpenWiz 0.0.6). Read-only. Each fact is stored once, in its read record's outcome; every other value points to it by id, or is worked out from the reads its dependency-table row names. Timestamps are integer milliseconds. contracts/fleet.v1.md has the rules this schema can't express.

orchestrator.description: Optional HTTP-only answer target: OPENWIZ_ORCHESTRATOR_THREAD_ID, positively checked to exist during this response. Omitted when unset, invalid or not confirmed; never null. Not supplied by the CLI.

cloudroom.description: null in the fleets view, which reads nothing from CloudRoom

github_source.description: gh's version is reported, never a gate.

cloudroom_source.description: room-cli's version is reported, never a gate (#37).

state.description: complete exactly when every read is complete

read.description: One external read: what was read, and its outcome, which holds its one interpreted result. The gaps are the reads that aren't complete.

oneOf.description: Which issues are specs: the fleets view's specs.
One issue's own fields: a spec's, a ticket's or a blocker's.
A ticket's blocked-by links: its blockers.
The pull request that closes an issue, with its own fields; null: none does.
An open pull request's checks, the latest run of each.
An open pull request's latest VERDICT; null: none.
Whether a merged pull request's merge commit is on its base.
The CloudRoom projects whose git remote is this repository.

read_id_or_null.description: A read id, or null when the value doesn't apply (no pull request, not merged).

failed.description: Nothing usable was read: no value. The reason is OpenWiz's own words.

unread.description: Not known: exactly the incomplete reads the value's dependency-table row reaches.

unknown.description: Every read is complete, and the state table doesn't settle the state.

undefined.description: Version 1 defines no read for this value.

repository.description: The GitHub repository's name, without its owner.

owned_paths.description: The body's one **Owned paths:** line, as written; null when there isn't exactly one, or it's empty.

relies_on.description: The body's one **Relies on:** line, as written; null when there isn't exactly one, or it's empty.

open_pr.description: An open pull request that closes the issue.

merged_pr.description: A pull request GitHub reports merged; the issue is merged only when its merge_readback is true.

several_prs.description: Two or more open pull requests with none merged, or (in `fleet`) two or more merged ones, close the issue: none of them is its.

commit.description: A full commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits.

review.description: The latest VERDICT comment (review-ticket: VERDICT: <APPROVE or CHANGES> at <the commit>).

cloud_thread.description: Its branch is its own workspace read.

local_thread.description: Its branch is the thread list's environmentBranchName; null: none.

fleets_view.description: openwiz fleets --json: every fleet, its tickets and blockers, and their counts.

fleet_view.description: openwiz fleet <spec> --json: one fleet's tickets, blockers and agents.

fleet.description: One spec: its issue and sub-issues reads, and its counts.

counts.description: tickets is the sum of the others; unknown counts that form.

ticket_core.description: One ticket in the fleets view: pointers to its reads, and its state.

state.description: Worked out by the state table from the reads its dependency-table row reaches.

ticket.description: One ticket in the fleet view, with its agents.

state.description: Worked out by the state table from the reads its dependency-table row reaches.

builder.description: The thread the verified chain places on its pull request; null: none (never that none exists).

blocker.description: An issue that blocks a ticket of the view: once, however many tickets it blocks.

fleet.description: The spec of the fleet in this view whose tickets list it; null: none.

merged.description: Its verified merge: its pull request is merged and read back on its base.

unplaced.description: A thread no verified chain places, and why.
